description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the ConfigService component of the OrangeHRM core service module. It contains unit tests that verify the behavior of ConfigService methods such as getter/setter methods for configuration keys, handling of exceptions, and retrieval of default configuration values. It uses mock objects for dependencies like ConfigDao and extends a KernelTestCase for setup.
